paper.title_en: Einstein--Yang--Mills Plane Waves: Uniqueness and an Exact Curvature Double Copy
paper.abstract_en: Coleman found plane waves of Yang--Mills theory that are genuinely non-abelian in four dimensions and yet obey linear field equations, and Güven showed that they remain exact when gravity is included. We study these waves in $D$ dimensions. Coleman's profile, which is linear in the transverse coordinates, is singled out twice: up to gauge, it is the only profile with bounded energy density, and the only one for which the full Riemann tensor equals the color-contracted square of the Yang--Mills field strength that sources it. In anti-de Sitter space, we construct a closed-form family for every $D\geq4$; there, the full Riemann tensor cannot equal this color square. Waves whose transverse space is a sphere are always singular. In quadratic and Gauss--Bonnet gravity, a hyperbolic transverse space avoids this only if the waves defocus light or the higher-curvature terms become comparable to the Einstein term. All solutions extend, with changed coefficients, to generic gravity and gauge theories.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究Einstein--Yang--Mills平面波在任意维度的性质，涉及Gauss-Bonnet与二次曲率引力等高阶曲率修正引力，属于modified_gravity范畴；理论推导有独特性与精确性论证，结构清晰，值得点开进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: Einstein--Yang--Mills平面波：唯一性与精确曲率对偶复制
decision.abstract_zh: Coleman发现了四维中真正非阿贝尔却仍满足线性场方程的Yang--Mills平面波，Güven则表明当纳入引力时它们依然精确。我们研究这些波在$D$维中的情形。Coleman的剖面（对横向坐标线性）被两次单独选出：在规范等价意义下，它是唯一具有有界能量密度的剖面，也是唯一使完整Riemann张量等于源它的Yang--Mills场强的色收缩平方的剖面。在反de Sitter空间中，我们对每个$D\geq4$构造出一个闭式族；在那里，完整Riemann张量不能等于该色平方。横向空间为球面的波总是奇异的。在二次引力和Gauss--Bonnet引力中，双曲横向空间只有在波使光散焦或高阶曲率项变得与Einstein项相当的情况下才避免这种奇异性。所有解都可（以改变的系数）推广到一般的引力与规范理论。
